name: Yoshizawa Haruo
source:
The second son of the Yoshizawa family and Natsuo's younger brother. He may look playful, but on the inside he's a serious and hard-working person. While going to high school, he works part-time to support his family. In charge of general cleaning in the Yoshizawa family.
